decisions.reason: As a specialized marine system that remained on the website into 2024, it likely carries certification and development costs and management can still justify weaker traction by long naval procurement cycles.

Although its visibility fell from a dedicated launch page in 2023 to a lighter mention in 2024, management is still inclined to continue with it because it extends the lighting range and disappointing results can be framed as a slow market ramp-up rather than failure.
Because it was still presented in 2024 as one of the firm's latest releases, management has made a visible public commitment and is therefore likely to persist with it.

This marine searchlight appears to have survived an early portfolio shakeout and, in a project-based niche market, management would tend to keep backing it given sunk engineering effort and the ability to blame weak sales on timing.
